node.title: Rate-quarter FPC5 M=4,t=2 is paid by pair uniqueness
node.statement: For an official rate-quarter maximal sunflower source with M=4, the source equation 4ell+b=3k+1 and b<ell imply 2ell>k-1. In one fixed source layout, two degree-below-k contributors touching the same unordered pair of full petals agree with the received word on more than k-1 points and are equal. Thus there are at most six non-planted M=4,t=2 contributors in that layout. General first-layout domination removes all source-layout multiplicity and adds at most M=4 anchors, giving the global absolute bound ten. Hence the full rate-quarter M=4,t=2 branch is polynomially paid.
